summary.headline: Signatureglobal H1 FY27 sales of about INR38 billion (~40% of INR100 billion annual target); FY guidance reiterated.
summary.overview: Management reiterated the INR100 billion FY27 sales guidance after H1 sales of about INR38 billion, roughly 675 units and 1.6 million sq ft, led by the Tonino Lamborghini Residences launch in Sector 71, Gurugram. H1 collections were about INR17 billion and the cash surplus about INR4.8 billion, with management expecting INR12-15 billion for the full year. Business development added about 10 million sq ft of developable area gross (net about 8.4 million sq ft), mainly Farrukhnagar (194 acres, of which 169 via collaboration) and about 31 acres near Project Dakshin in Sohna. H1 revenue recognition from completions was about INR14 billion, with H1 gross margin about 31%, EBITDA margin 13% and PAT about INR50 crore; management targets about INR50 billion of completions for FY27.

financial_highlights.change: above previous full-year average, as stated
previous 8-10 quarters steady at about INR10 billion per quarter; Q2 was lower

financial_highlights.metric: H1 cash surplus (pre land and debt repayment)

financial_highlights.change: gross debt INR28.7 billion, cash about INR24 billion plus

segments.name: Residential (mid-income)
segments.commentary: Core business in Delhi NCR; delivered about 19 million sq ft to date, with about 9 million sq ft nearing delivery. Management says about 50-51 million sq ft remains in the pipeline.

segments.name: Branded residences (Tonino Lamborghini Residences, Sector 71 SPR)
segments.commentary: First branded project with more than 800 units, launched in June per analyst question; management described the response as strong. Brokerage around 4% (range 3-5%).

segments.name: Mixed-use / yield (RMZ JV, SPR Gurugram)
segments.commentary: About 5.6 million sq ft office-led mixed-use project with two hotels and a design district, acquired March 30; design and approvals in progress, no launch or construction start yet, mostly yield portfolio.

segments.name: Plotted developments (City of Colours Manesar, Project Dakshin industrial plots)
segments.commentary: Both nearing completion with completion approvals expected in FY27; these drive revenue recognition and collections but carry low construction spend.

guidance_outlook: FY27 sales guidance of INR100 billion maintained; management expects about 40% in H1 and 60% in H2.
FY27 completions guidance of about INR50 billion reiterated, with large lumpy completions expected in H2.
Collections expected to improve significantly in H2; FY27 operating cash flow guided at INR12-15 billion.
Business development in FY27 expected to be of the order of operating cash flow (INR12-15 billion) with no significant impact on debt.

Construction cost escalation for FY27 expected in the late single digits (7-9% long-run); H1 construction spend above prior year's, but full-year construction cost not expected to reach INR2,000 crore, as stated.

Planned H2 launches: about 2 million+ sq ft in Sector 71 (next to Tonino Lamborghini Residences), a single-tower Dwarka Expressway project, about 400 units in Dakshin (Sohna), and about 0.3-0.4 million sq ft in Sector 37D.
capex_capacity: Farrukhnagar (Gurugram): 194-acre parcel (25 acres acquired, 169 acres via collaboration), planned as farmhouse/villa community with a small resort; outside zoned area, launch will take time.
Sohna: about 31 acres added via collaboration near Project Dakshin (about 125 acres); further about 2.7 million sq ft potential to come in H2.
Dakshin (Sohna) has about 2,800 units overall, of which about 400 units are pending launch.
Business development in H1 added about 10 million sq ft gross developable area versus 1.6 million sq ft sold.
GRAP/NGT construction bans are planned for: company assumes about 10 working months per year.
demand_pricing: Realisations crossed INR17,000 per sq ft at portfolio level; site-to-site price escalations in single digits.
Management says secondary-market prices are rising due to limited secondary stock, supporting primary pricing.
Sales in H1 were not heavy on new launches; management says there is no significant incremental unsold inventory.
ANAROCK data (cited): top-7 city sales crossed 1 lakh units in Q3 2026, up 10% QoQ; NCR prices up 12% YoY, fastest among top seven.
Farrukhnagar farmhouse product is priced far below Delhi farmhouses that sell above INR100 crore, as stated; no market size given.

qa_highlights.question: What launches are expected in Q3 and Q4 FY27, and what GDV?
qa_highlights.answer: Launches planned in Sector 71 (2 million+ sq ft, timing not fixed), another 2 million+ sq ft next to Tonino Lamborghini, a single tower on Dwarka Expressway, about 400 units in Sohna, and 0.3-0.4 million sq ft in Sector 37D. No GDV given.

qa_highlights.question: What is the full-year BD spend, given about INR500 crore in H1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give a figure; said BD would be of the order of operating cash flow (INR12-15 billion) for the year and would not materially affect debt.

qa_highlights.question: Why were sustenance sales below the usual INR2,000 crore run rate?
qa_highlights.answer: H1 was targeted at about 40% of annual sales and was not heavy on launches; management said H1 is in line with the annual target and inventory is not building up.

qa_highlights.question: Size of the Farrukhnagar farmhouse market and share targeted?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said no market size is available; the product is a first-of-its-kind organised farmhouse offering, priced well below the Delhi farmhouse segment.

qa_highlights.question: Confidence in collections and OCF guidance given slower tracking?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reiterated annual guidance, citing H2 completions that should lift collections and OCF.

qa_highlights.question: How does GRAP affect construction and how is it planned?
qa_highlights.answer: Recurring issue; plan assumes about 10 working months per year. Material is available with stocking during bans, and guidance already factors in weeks lost.

qa_highlights.question: Why did H1 construction cash spend fall versus last year (INR880 crore vs INR970 crore)?
qa_highlights.answer: Two plotted projects (City of Colours in Manesar and industrial plots in Dakshin) need heavy development work but low construction spend; both near completion.

qa_highlights.question: Why did the Tonino Lamborghini launch value fall from INR44 billion to INR43 billion?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it was not sure of the reason and would address it separately.

risks_watch: Collections: Q2 collections were lower than the INR10 billion per quarter trend in the prior 8-10 quarters; H2 collections must improve sharply to hit OCF of INR12-15 billion.
Completions: INR50 billion FY27 completion target depends on lumpy H2 completions and completion approvals for City of Colours and Dakshin plots.
Sales: H2 must deliver about 60% of the INR100 billion target, relying on launches not yet dated.
GRAP/NGT construction bans recur each year and can cut working time.
Farrukhnagar and RMZ mixed-use projects have long timelines before revenue and are unlaunched.
Launch value change for Tonino Lamborghini (INR44 billion to INR43 billion) left unexplained.
summary.management_tone: Confident and reassuring on guidance, reiterating all four annual targets; cautious and vague on specifics such as launch dates, GDV, BD spend, and the reason for the launch-value revision.
key_quotes: So, the way we look at this number is that as part of our business plan at the start of the year, typically is to do about 40% of the sales in the first half and try to do about 60% of the sales in the second half.
So on all four parameters, whether it is launches, sales, collection, or revenue recognition basis completions, we stay put to our guidance at the start of the year.
Now, the first half has also not been very heavy on new launches.

adds.what: Sector 71 Gurugram H2 launch of about 2 million+ sq ft (next to Tonino Lamborghini Residences)
About 400 units Dakshin (Sohna) pending launch in H2
About 0.3-0.4 million sq ft Sector 37D launch

growth.why: Management reiterated INR100bn FY27 pre-sales and INR50bn completions guidance after H1 sales of about INR38bn (~40% of target), with H2 launches (2mn+ sq ft Sector 71, Dakshin ~400 units, Sector 37D, Dwarka Expressway) and H1 completions of ~INR14bn; backing is partial since launch timing is given but no firm H2 sales contracts are quantified beyond the H1 run-rate.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: H1 gross margin was about 31% and EBITDA margin 13% (Q2 gross 36%, EBITDA 18%), with large lumpy completions in H2 but construction cost escalation guided at 7-9% and realisations up with single-digit site escalations.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Planned H2 launches of 2mn+ sq ft in Sector 71, a single-tower Dwarka Expressway project, about 400 Dakshin units and 0.3-0.4mn sq ft in Sector 37D, with Farrukhnagar and RMZ mixed-use unlaunched and long-dated, so no new capacity in the 2-4 quarter window beyond these launches.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H1 sold about 675 units / 1.6mn sq ft (~40% of INR100bn), with management expecting 60% of sales in H2 from four planned launches, though H2 volume is not yet quantified.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Business development spend is guided to match operating cash flow of INR12-15 billion, and H1 BD added about 10mn sq ft gross, but no new plant or capex is discussed, so a land/project capex announcement is conditional rather than firm.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management only reiterated the INR100 billion sales and INR50 billion completions guidance after H1 sales of about INR38 billion (~40% of target), with H2 needing about 60% and Q2 collections falling well below the INR10 billion quarterly trend.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H2 must deliver about 60% of the INR100 billion sales target from undated launches, collections must rebound from H1 INR17 billion to fund INR12-15 billion OCF, and GRAP bans assumed at about 10 working months per year could slow construction.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Sector 71 2mn+ sq ft, Dwarka Expressway single tower, about 400 Dakshin units and Sector 37D 0.3-0.4mn sq ft are all guided for H2, with Farrukhnagar farmhouse product still outside zoned area and taking longer.

rows.label: H2 sales ramp to INR60bn from launches
rows.why: H2 must deliver about 60% of the INR100 billion target (about INR62 billion) after H1 INR38 billion, dependent on undated Sector 71 and other launches.

rows.label: Collections recovery to fund OCF of INR12-15bn
rows.why: H1 collections about INR17 billion with Q2 below the steady INR10 billion per quarter run-rate; H2 must lift collections sharply, and management ties this to H2 completions.

rows.label: GRAP/NGT construction bans
rows.why: Company assumes about 10 working months per year, so recurring bans in winter months will cut construction time and can slow completions.

tone.note: Management was confident in reiterating INR100bn sales, INR50bn completions and INR12-15bn OCF, but vague on launch dates, GDV, BD spend and the reason for the Tonino Lamborghini launch-value cut; analysts pressed on H2 sales and collections.
